profile.headline: Software Engineer at Third Act Media Distribution
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer focused on e-commerce. I build and maintain Shopify storefronts with Liquid, TypeScript, and headless Hydrogen, along with React Native mobile apps, covering catalog and collections, cart and checkout, preorders, wholesale, and customer accounts through Shopify's Storefront and Customer Account APIs.

Before that, I spent several years as a web developer at MNTN and QuickFrame, maintaining WordPress sites, managing design systems with designers, and integrating HubSpot, Marketo, and Google Tag Manager. I also work in PHP, JavaScript, Bootstrap, SASS, and Webpack.

Earlier in my career I worked in fashion e-commerce operations on Amazon, handling order fulfillment, inventory, and customer service, then moved into data work with Excel and Python. This background helps me with building for online stores.

Outside client work, I'm building a native file manager in Rust and Swift.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Building a Shopify retail store theme with Liquid, including product listing for retail, preorder, and wholesale
- Ensure full flow for bag, checkout, and customer service with a chat service and a contact form.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
- Maintain a Wordpress website for a non-profit organization providing financial and support services for clients.
- Built a real estate investor portal website for Cisterra, a commercial property developer, with authentication and user management using FaunaDB, AWS S3 for cloud storage, and NextJS for frontend.
- Maintained 2 websites for a school, St Paul the Apostle Catholic School, to modify their design and improve pages.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Maintained custom themes using ACF for three public websites hosted on WPEngine.
- Used Lottie, SVG, SASS, JavaScript, Adobe XD, and After Effects to incorporate graphs and animations throughout the website.
- Used Hubspot and Marketo, for email templates, and landing pages.
- Integrated Google Tag Manager for Google Analytics and event tracking for marketing.
- Used Bootstrap to implement design guidelines and create components.
- Built masonry gallery pages with infinite scroll with state management using Redux that persists across pages and reloads.
- Maintained server and client side logic using JS and PHP with Wordpress.
- Restructured the codebase by isolating components with unit testing in Jest, and splitting global and page specific scripts.
- Reduced build size through code splitting with Webpack to improve build and load time.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained recruitment pages for clients like Disney, Sony, Spectrum, and Capital One.
- Developed with internal CMS using Razor, jQuery, vanilla JavaScript, and SASS.
- Worked in a team with project managers, creatives, customer support specialists, and UI Developers.

positions.title: Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Created a React app from scratch with Webpack and configured the Node, Express, and MySQL backend.
- Revamped the existing website from statically served html pages to a React and Node based full-stack web app.
- Configured and wrote unit & integrated tests with Mocha and Chai.
- Worked as a team lead in an agile environment using Trello and Bitbucket.

positions.title: Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
Colorpicker
https://colorpicker-client.herokuapp.com
- Colorpicker is a color palette creator website.  Users can adjust each colors dynamically with HSL sliders and save them to the database.  The dashboard will provide access to all the palettes.

Textbottle
https://textbottle.herokuapp.com
- Textbottle is a WYSIWYG text editor.  Users are provided with Medium-like formatting options which hovers over the text area.  Documents will be automatically saved to the account.

MiniMaps
https://jsphkm.github.io/MiniMaps/
- MiniMaps is a basic implementation of Google Maps API's.  Finding current geolocation is available for quick insertion of the starting point.  The details about the end location includes drive time, name, address, rating, operating hours, open/closed, website, and phone number.

positions.title: Data Specialist
positions.description:
- Wrote and maintained Python scripts to extract and parse text from PDF files.
- Performed data cleansing in Excel and Python, which included formatting, detecting duplicates, and other types of human errors.
- Developed a method to backup the database with Python scripts.
- Produced ad-hoc reports of the work orders and invoices for senior management and clients.
- Generated weekly summaries and status reports for senior management and clients.

positions.title: Assistant General Manager
positions.description:
- Oversaw the packaging and shipping of the fashion products.
- Supervised warehouse teams and the daily operations.
- Provided full customer service in a timely manner.
- Listed the products by their categories on Amazon.

positions.title: Customer Service and Warehouse Manager
positions.description:
- Managed logistics regarding shipping, inventory, and customer service on Amazon and on Linnworks, an order management software.
- Regularly monitored Amazon's seller performance measurements and achieved high level of service by exceeding targets as needed.
- Strengthened customer relation policies to retain and provide personal connections through the Amazon shopping experience.
- Worked closely with buyers and inspected the purchases for inventory quality control.
- Identified product listing errors and addressed those details for revisions or improvements.

positions.title: Shipping Supervisor
positions.description:
- Processed Amazon orders through company's order management software
- Worked with USPS and FedEx to troubleshoot software problems
- Monitored the warehouse workflow and improved efficiency

positions.title: Data Entry Clerk
positions.description:
- Received and sorted the work orders in preparation for data entry.
- Kept records of the invoices using Excel.
- Quickly and accurately entered the data into the relational database system using the 10-key pad setup.
- Established an archival system focused on easy retrieval of information stored in past work orders and invoices.
- Provided computer and software assistance.

positions.title: Technical Support Engineer
positions.description:
- Repaired and upgraded server computers and security cameras.
- Provided technical support for onsite installers and IT's.
- Demonstrated showroom products and answered technical questions for customers.

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Worked on event photography/videography, audio engineering, and music performance.
- Created shirt designs using Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop
- Videographed the homeless outreach and survey services provided by the community volunteers.
